notes.normalization: (pixel - 127.5) / 128.0, as used by the upstream SCRFD inference reference. The uint16 input quantization (zero_point 32768, scale 3.03988327e-05) spans about [-0.996, 0.996]. Golden tensor parity remains required.
notes.color_matrix: BT.709 limited is assumed from an HD FW NV12 source. Confirm against golden; a BT.601 source must not use BT.709 coefficients.
notes.channel_order: RGB is assumed. Confirm against golden.
notes.pad_value: The upstream SCRFD inference reference resizes with preserved aspect ratio and copies the resized image at (0,0) into a zero-filled tensor canvas. Golden tensor parity remains required.
notes.coordinates: The decoder consumes stride-unit distances and applies the inverse letterbox; the tensor-space convention is not a decoder.json coordinate field for this kind.
